items.reason: Gap 0 describes the same event delivered twice at once, checked before the handler and recorded after, so it is processed twice.
Gap 1 says deduplication uses the unsigned X-Event-Id header rather than the signed body id, so a spoofed header subverts it.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded but the code handles refund.created, so refunds match no handler.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
